title: REQ · Run retries up to the configured limit and stops when the budget is exceeded
summary: Agent failures are retried up to MaxRetries and accumulated cost above MaxBudget stops the run
description: Context: config exposes MaxRetries and MaxBudget. Desired behavior: Run attempts the agent up to MaxRetries+1 times, recording Execution.Attempt, summing cost returned by each attempt, and stopping with ErrBudgetExceeded as soon as total cost exceeds MaxBudget. Expected result: bounded, budget-safe agent runs. Why: avoid runaway cost and endless loops.
acceptance_criteria: Given an agent failing twice then succeeding and MaxRetries 2, when Run is called, then the agent is called 3 times and the stored Attempt is 3
Given an agent that always fails and MaxRetries 1, when Run is called, then the agent is called 2 times, the status is FAILED and Error contains the agent error
Given each attempt costs 3.0 and MaxBudget 5.0, when the second attempt finishes, then Run returns an error satisfying errors.Is(err, ErrBudgetExceeded) and no third attempt runs

in_scope: retry loop in Run's execute step

technical_constraints: Budget check runs after each attempt, including a failed one
